contexts.text: Wound = that faith is desolated; bruise, that charity is devastated.
That this evil consumes the remains of good and truth, is signified by... his seed is devastated ().
Under Desolate, see this reference.
The extinction of faith without charity, and thus the devastation of truth with them. Signified.
The process of their devastation is described by the eleven plagues inflicted on the Egyptians.
Thus total devastation. Signified.

Pestilence = the vastation of truth and good; here, total devastation... Before, by pestilence is not signified total devastation, but vastation in general as to those things which are of the truth and good of the Church, and which are outside.
Thus (infernal Spirits) vastate themselves; and this does not cease with them until they have completely devastated themselves.
Hence, too, it is, that when infernal Spirits have been devastated, they are in the extremes of the Natural...
The evil are devastated as the Lord ordains Heaven; for the influx of good and truth from Heaven effects devastation with the evil...
For they who infest have been devastated as to these truths...
(The wicked who infest are successively conjoined with many Hells) before they are fully devastated.

This ordination effects that the evil are by degrees devastated. Explained... Hence it is, that there are degrees of devastation, even until they are at last cast into Hell, which is the last of the degrees of vastation.

When the evil are being devastated in the other life, it is often given them to perceive whence come the evils of punishment with them, in order that they may know that... they themselves are the cause. Signified.
About the middle of the night = when there is total devastation. Explained. AC 7947.
The devastation of the evil in the other life... does not come immediately from the Spirit who is in evil, but it comes from the Hells...

When the evil have been devastated as to all truth and good, and have been left to the evil and thence the falsity of their own life, the Hells with which they have communicated through the evils of their life are opened...
Devastation and damnation thence from themselves. Signified.
Thus they devastate themselves. Explained.
Further lamentations over the devastation of the Church. Signified.
Under Consummation, see these references. AR 658. AR 658:2. AR 674. a. AR 676:3. TCR 755:end. TCR 758:2.
Devastated in one hour () = that on account of the destruction of that religiosity, no one can hereafter buy their holy things.
(The use of devastations.)
At last he comes into a state of devastation.
Such cannot be amended... but are wholly devastated...
The keen-sightedness of the evil before they are fully devastated.
On devastations in general.
He is then devastated... and thus falls into his own Hell, and is wholly in evil and falsity.
The devastated cities which they will build () = doctrinal things... hitherto destroyed, and then to be restored.
Devastation () = that there is good no longer; breaking, that there is truth no longer.
Vastation... is signified by I will devastate ().
When ye shall see the abomination of devastation = when they will see the Church to be devastated, which is when there is no longer any truth because there is no good.
Devastated = no perception of it.
The devastation of beasts () = the destruction of truths through cupidities of evil.
They are gone because of devastation () = turning away from the Lord through the falsification of truth.
Under Cup, see this reference.
Under Pit, see this reference.
Occurs.
Devastated = destroyed.
Under Destroy, see this reference.
On the devastation of the Church in general and in especial. Explained.
Devastation and destruction as to all things of doctrine with them. Signified.
Manifestation by the Lord concerning the devastation of the Church as to the good of love and of charity. Signified.
The seven plagues = evils and falsities in the whole complex, which completely devastate the Church.
Thus is the Church devastated. Explained.
Devastation is predicated of good; desolation, of truth.
